decisions.reason: The mitred door lever handle family remains well aligned with the firm's architecture-led core range, though management will monitor overlap after already pruning one 2023 handle line.
The multifunctional door lever handle supports the firm's barrier-free and system-solution positioning, so it is still more likely to be retained than discontinued.

This door lever handle family sits squarely in the firm's established hardware business and would normally be kept to serve specifiers, installers and stockists, despite some portfolio rationalization risk.
The door and window handle collection looks like a flagship design family with proven recognition, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
A finish is easier to streamline than a full hardware family, but the light patinated bronze option still fits the firm's premium architectural offering and is likely to stay for now.
